et.title: Core’i seadistused, hooldus ja uuendused
et.description: **System → Settings** haldab kohalikku administraatorit, paigalduse identiteeti, Getting Started nähtavust ja Core’i väljalaskeinfot. Ametliku kataloogi haldus asub **Integrations → Extaas Connect** all.
et.keywords: Extaas Workspace, seaded, konto seadistamine, ettevõtte profiil, kasutajad, tööruum

en.title: Core settings, maintenance and updates
en.description: **System → Settings** manages the local administrator, installation identity, Getting Started visibility and Core release information. Official catalogue controls belong to **Integrations → Extaas Connect**.
en.keywords: Extaas Workspace, settings, account setup, company profile, users, workspace
